summary: Tested the Direct Projects rework (both backend and frontend). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed. They cover Multitienda (multistore with per-branch box_count), Multi Marca (multirif with rifs/stores), Monotienda (single), BANCO with a sponsor bank (sponsored_implementation true), CLIENTE removing a sent bank, rejection of a branch with 0 boxes, and Gateway without scope_tree. UI: dp-params-card and dp-integration-card are present. dp-type-simple, dp-type-multirif and dp-multistore-toggle are gone, and so are the texts Modelo de Precios, Bancos/Entes, Exento de IVA, Servicio Express and Control Multitienda. The tipologia tag showed MULTITIENDA, then MONOTIENDA, then MULTI MARCA as expected. Sponsor type defaults to Cliente. Choosing Banco shows dp-sponsor-bank and the error chip, and picking a bank clears the error. Fiscal printer 'Otro' opens the custom input, which is validated. For Gateway, the level selector and dp-hw-section are hidden and the client combobox appears. E2E: a VPOS Multi Marca project (Cubitt + VIVA BOLEITA, 3 branches, 4 boxes) was created through the UI with Reel Mercantil/Pago C2P, MSC server, VPN and printer Aclas. DB checks passed: origin=direct, tipo_proyecto=DIRECTO, tipologia_proyecto=Multi Marca, project_type=multirif, 2 rifs (1 and 3 boxes), 3 stores, fiscal_printer_model saved, patrocinador_tipo=CLIENTE, sponsored_implementation=false. /projects/<id> shows Multi Marca. Edición Maestra (master edit) shows the branches. All test projects were deleted.

minor.issue: patrocinador_tipo='BANCO' without sponsor_bank_id is accepted (200) and silently creates a non-sponsored project. Only the frontend validates this. Add a 400 in the backend.
patrocinador_tipo is not validated against {CLIENTE, BANCO}. Its value is upper-cased as-is.

patrocinador_tipo and patrocinador_nombre are not saved on the project when there is no scope_tree. quote_transitions copies them only inside the scope_tree block, so a Gateway project sponsored by a bank or client loses this field (project.patrocinador_tipo=None).

ui_bugs.issue: dp-tipologia-tag shows MONOTIENDA before any client is selected
For a Multi Marca project (project_type=multirif), the banks section badge says 'Multitienda'

issues: The tipologia appears twice: the dp-tipologia-tag in the header and the 'Tipología del proyecto' line (scope-tipologia) inside the selector. This is redundant.
The 'Modelo Pinpad *' label has an asterisk but the field is optional (it is not validated)
The sticky footer partly covers the serial-section buttons (Plantilla/Cargar Excel/Manual) while scrolling

action_items: Backend: return 400 when patrocinador_tipo=BANCO has no sponsor_bank_id/sponsor_processor_id, and validate patrocinador_tipo against {CLIENTE, BANCO}
Save patrocinador_tipo/patrocinador_nombre on Gateway/Link de Pago projects (no scope_tree)
Hide dp-tipologia-tag in Gateway mode until a client is selected
Optional: remove the duplicated tipologia display, the asterisk on Modelo Pinpad, and the Multitienda badge for multirif in Edición Maestra
critical_code_review_comments: DirectProjectCreation.jsx is 1458 lines and direct_projects.py is 988 lines. Both are over 700 lines and should be split (Reel/grid, serials and attachments into their own components).

Dead legacy code remains in the form and backend: is_multistore/stores, multirif_distribution and multirif_sponsorship validations, even though the UI no longer exposes them. The frontend always sends project_type='simple'.

In MARCA/GRUPO mode, payload.economic_group falls back to the first client's group (e.g. 'Casiolandia' for Cubitt+VIVA) when grupo_economico_name is missing. This may not represent a multi-brand project.
